run_train_watermark_model: run the watermark embedding and detection training pipeline with configurable optimizer and scheduler
run_eval_watermark_model: run evaluation of the trained watermark model on validation data with multiple augmentations
build_watermark_training_pipeline: build a distributed training pipeline with embedder, extractor, augmenter, and perceptual loss
test_watermark_robustness: test watermark detection robustness across geometric and value metric augmentations
test_multi_watermark_detection: test detection of multiple watermarks per image with segmentation and rectangle masks
